many.reason: Events grid wraps responsively with no truncation or pagination; more events only add rows, not a distinct visual state.

loading.reason: Fully static (statically-exported) page with content collections resolved at build; no async/loading state.

edge.reason: Optional-field branches (an event with no link) are exercised within the typical scenario; no distinct edge layout.

error.reason: Static content page with no data fetching; no failure/error state can occur.

error.reason: FOLLOW-UP, not absent: @codeyam/cms 0.2.0 added real in-page failure surfaces to this view — CommitErrorNotice for a failed commit and DriftNotice for a branch that moved under a staged change — so the previous justification that no error surface exists is out of date. Not captured in this repo because both components live in node_modules and are unreachable to editor isolate, and rendering either requires a failing or drifted GitHub commit with no .codeyam/mockable declarations in this project. Capturing it means standing up mock declarations for the CMS GitHub transport, which belongs with the package rather than this consumer.
